values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Require complete provenance-preserving rows and exact owner, scope, disposition, evidence, fix/review/PR/merge fields where applicable.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('docs/reviews/v0.92/remediation-5848/dispositions.json')); abort 'empty finding universe' unless r['rows'].is_a?(Array) && !r['rows'].empty?; abort 'incomplete row' unless r['rows'].all? { |x| %w[id source severity evidence owner disposition].all? { |k| x[k] } }

lanes.proof_role: Reject open actionable, stale fix/review SHA, unmerged, failed, missing-proof, unowned follow-on, or unauthorized accepted-risk rows.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('docs/reviews/v0.92/remediation-5848/validation.json')); abort 'remediation blockers remain' unless r['blockers'].is_a?(Array) && r['blockers'].empty?

lanes.proof_role: Re-run every affected WP-22 row and release-facing claim check at each exact merged remediation revision.
Validate the exact rendered six-card bundle, cross-card references, digests, statuses, and canonical issue record.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on false completion claims, path collisions, invalid lifecycle state, or missing named proof; preserve a specific blocker instead of degrading.
